title: Spotsee Well Distribution Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Select appropriate pipette
steps.instruction: If the volume to dispense is less than 20 µL, use a P20 single‑channel pipette with matching tips; if the volume is greater than 20 µL, use a P300 single‑channel pipette with matching tips.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired liquid volumes, well locations, and any other required settings in the protocol parameter fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and, if it is compressed, unzip it to access the .py file.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware files (JSON extensions) for the 80‑well plate, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Place the tip rack, the custom 80‑well plate, and any other required labware on the deck positions indicated in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tip rack, the custom labware, and the selected pipette; follow the app’s prompts or support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to start the liquid‑addition protocol.
